answers.core: AnimatedSprite was created to make animations easier for beginners, adding this feature will make it easy to support common animation transitions using this simple node.
answers.workaround:
Possible workarounds:
- use custom dictionary state machine and connect to AnimatedSprite's signals. Disadvantages: more cumbersome than AnimationTree, more work, harder to maintain,
- use AnimationPlayer and sprite sheet instead of single sprite frames and AnimatedSprite. Disadvantages: 
    - requires additional work in order to merge sprite frames into a sprite sheet,
    - using spritesheets may hurt performance for larger sprites with a lot of frames
    - setting specific FPS is more difficult (especially when adding/removing frames to the animation),
- use AnimationPlayer to animate AnimatedSprite properties like "playing" or "animation". Disadvantages: redundant, weird, confusing and a really bad design.

title: Support using AnimatedSprite and AnimationTree together
